project: Andaz Vibe Stay - Arambol, Goa / private mobile-first website overhaul
strategy: Research the live system first; prevent fabricated marketing content or inventory. Build a distinctive STAY → CONNECT → PLAY → RESET journey that sends a guest from intent through room availability to a truthful booking or WhatsApp path, with Moksha identified as an external wellness partner. Conduct source-verified research and a source-to-claim audit before defining UX, then design page-level mobile wireframes and authentic asset/copy maps. Plan code only in a separately authorized private WordPress staging environment with existing PMS preserved, backups, consent-aware tracking, enforced authorization and independent browser/booking/security/SEO QA. Research and photo preparation may run in parallel with UX once T1 is verified. Booking adapter and front-end implementation require separate approvals and verified contracts. Deliver an auditable launch decision dossier; do not publish.
assumptions: Current live Andaz website URL, theme, plugins and booking status must be verified rather than assumed.
PMS is an existing bespoke workflow; treat booking inventory, pricing and auth behavior as source-controlled truth.
Approved real photographs and use permissions must be collected or site must retain clearly marked internal placeholders.
Existing kitchen/café operating status is unverified and excluded from promotional claims.
Moksha is a separate brand serving as a wellness partner, not a room type or hotel amenity owned by Andaz.
risks: Existing booking/PMS coupling may be fragile; isolate adapter changes and require replayable synthetic regression fixtures.
Third-party OTA pricing becomes stale quickly; require dated checkout sources and avoid publishing scraped claims.
Hostel photos, facilities and kitchen claims risk misleading guests; impose content-to-evidence approval.
Mobile design effects and third-party widgets can harm Core Web Vitals; set baseline and compare before/after.
Untrusted plugins and guest data flows create security/privacy exposure; minimize PII, prevent logging and constrain staging.
SEO migrations can erase valuable URLs and duplicate schema; preserve canonical mapping and redirects.
Mac reviewer is not currently confirmed available; release cannot assume independent cross-host peer QA.

milestones.name: Verified current-state and conversion research
milestones.outcome: Dated source-of-truth inventory, baseline booking journey, approved competitor evidence, risk register

milestones.name: Mobile-first product design
milestones.outcome: Reviewed information architecture, representative wireframes, copy and real-image map, interaction specifications

milestones.name: Isolated implementation proposal
milestones.outcome: Private staging environment plan, non-destructive front-end modules and approved PMS/WhatsApp integration design

milestones.name: Independent validation and security
milestones.outcome: Traceable mobile, booking, privacy, SEO, accessibility, performance and rollback evidence

milestones.name: Owner-reviewed release readiness
milestones.outcome: An approval-ready, unpublished release dossier with explicit remaining blockers

tasks.objective: Inventory the currently canonical Andaz website, hosting, WordPress theme/plugins, PMS dependencies, URLs and source-control ownership without changing production.
deliverables: Source-verified architecture inventory with timestamps and confidence labels
Canonical URL and booking-source map plus known/unknown register
acceptance: Every assertion links to inspected source, owner evidence, or is marked unverified
Booking engine, hosting and protected configurations are not guessed

tasks.objective: Analyze guest personas, reservation intent and 2–3 genuinely comparable Arambol hostels/OTA checkout flows within website terms, with dated pricing only where lawful and independently observed.
deliverables: Source-linked comparison matrix and user intent hypothesis
Research gaps, terms/robots and price-evidence ledger
acceptance: Every competitor claim has source URL, access date, and fact-versus-inference label
No invented room rate, availability or source claim

tasks.objective: Establish mobile-funnel baselines and booking journey inventory, including click-to-WhatsApp, date, room, availability, errors and repeat-guest paths.
deliverables: User-journey and analytics event inventory
Prioritized conversion blockers with explicit unavailable-data labels
acceptance: Lists at least three primary mobile paths and verified instrumentation status
No production analytics or PMS data collected without approval

tasks.objective: Define the STAY → CONNECT → PLAY → RESET information architecture, clear mobile-first navigation and booking-first page-level wireframes without a generic hostel theme or giant hero booking widget.
deliverables: Sitemap for home, rooms, experience, Moksha partner, about, FAQ, contact, policies
360px and 390px home/rooms/booking wireframes with CTA placement
acceptance: Each primary page has goal, intent, headline, CTA, key evidence and mobile layout
Room availability and WhatsApp booking require at most an explicitly measured few taps, not arbitrary promises

tasks.objective: Develop accurate content/imagery inventory using real Andaz photos and owner-confirmed amenities; treat kitchen and unverified services as not public.
deliverables: Content matrix with owner-approved photo IDs, rights, descriptions and alt text
Truth-label matrix for room types, pool, events, Moksha partner and kitchen
acceptance: Every image slot is backed by a verified property photo or clearly labeled staging placeholder
No operational kitchen/café, unverified rates or availability claims

tasks.objective: Specify a cohesive original mobile-first brand design system emphasizing Andaz social energy and Moksha as a distinctly identified partner, without generic palm clichés.
deliverables: Design token sheet, reusable components and accessible interaction states
Approved responsive layouts, CTA hierarchy, typography, spacing, contrast and reduced-motion specs
acceptance: Documents breakpoints, keyboard focus and WCAG 2.2 AA targets
Distinguishes hostel offerings from Moksha services

tasks.objective: Prepare a private, authenticated, indexed-no, production-isolated WordPress staging workflow with immutable pre-change snapshot, rollback checkpoints and change register.
deliverables: Staging/environment design, backup/restore dry-run plan, secrets boundaries
Implementation checklist and idempotent change log template
acceptance: No real inventory write, booking email or payment from staging without a safe test fixture
Rollback steps and owners are explicit; production stays unchanged

tasks.objective: Implement proposed mobile templates and components from approved designs on private staging only; prioritize performance, responsive image handling and truthful room cards.
deliverables: Component/module breakdown for home, rooms, experiences, Moksha and FAQ
Private preview acceptance artifacts and source-to-layout trace
acceptance: All templates have mobile-first variants and accessible CTA states
No code release to live site or fabricated property images

tasks.objective: Map and safely integrate the existing PMS to availability, room/bed selection, WhatsApp handoff and returning-guest paths; preserve current validation and transaction behavior.
deliverables: Booking state machine and PMS adapter contract; no new authority or credentials
Detailed test-data matrix and negative-path acceptance tests
acceptance: Inventory is derived solely from the verified PMS; unavailable data fails clearly
Existing live booking paths remain unchanged and regression-covered

tasks.objective: Plan evidence-based SEO, local structured data, search snippets, canonical routes, redirect integrity and consent-aware analytics instrumentation.
deliverables: Page-by-page title/description/heading/canonical matrix
Event tracking schema for room click, availability, WhatsApp and booking errors
acceptance: No duplicate/conflicting structured data or invented reviews/prices
Tracking follows consent requirements and preserves existing tags

tasks.objective: Threat-model WordPress, PMS and any guest ID upload; specify auth/permission checks, PII minimization, staging data safety, logging redaction and secret handling.
deliverables: Data-flow diagram and security threat register
Permission/ID redaction/consent review checklist with owners
acceptance: No personal guest data placed into model prompts or public staging
Security checks are enforceable outside model-written instructions

tasks.objective: Run independent mobile usability, responsive, accessibility and image authenticity QA on representative viewport widths and keyboard/screen-reader journeys.
deliverables: Browser QA matrix at 360/390/768/1280px, mobile screenshots and bug tickets
Accessibility audit and real-image verification ledger
acceptance: No horizontal overflow, clipped primary CTA or inaccessible date/room controls
Critical accessibility issues and fake/misleading imagery block approval

tasks.objective: Test booking-end-to-end and negative paths with synthetic fixtures only: dates, room/bed types, stock depletion, invalid country codes, repeat guests and WhatsApp deep links.
deliverables: Independent sandbox booking regression results and error-path captures
Cross-check of PMS state versus rendered inventory across fixtures
acceptance: No oversell or successful booking claim without verified end-to-end evidence
Returning-guest data, required ID flows and failure recovery meet approved policy

tasks.objective: Run read-only threat, plugin configuration and booking security reviews with isolated negative probes; document findings before any release consideration.
deliverables: Evidence-backed plugin/authorization/security findings with severity
Negative test receipts for unauthorized source edits and privacy boundaries
acceptance: Unresolved critical security issues stop signoff
No privileged shell, production permission change or live transaction

tasks.objective: Audit performance and SEO against real preview evidence, verify web-vitals targets where measurable, and rehearse rollback without public deployment.
deliverables: Lighthouse/Web Vitals, canonical/redirect, event and sitemap QA evidence
Isolated rollback rehearsal with data-integrity and uptime expectations
acceptance: Targets LCP ≤2.5s, INP ≤200ms and CLS ≤0.1 on representative mobile field data when available; otherwise label lab-only
No broken booking or SEO regression; all failures are tracked

tasks.objective: Present owner with concise evidence pack, signed decisions, unresolved risks, approved images/copy, booking test receipts, rollback plan and staged screenshots; request separate launch approval.
deliverables: Owner-facing release decision memo and blocking-issues register
Traceability matrix from each original requirement to tested evidence
acceptance: Human approver explicitly accepts content, booking and rollback evidence
No automatic merge, spend, production deploy, or publication
